title: TXAM Shines at CIBF International Battery Exhibition, "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" Attracts Attention
contentHtml:
In May 2025, TXAM showcased its self-developed "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" and other core equipment at the CIBF International Battery Technology Exhibition, marking its full entry into new energy and smart warehousing logistics sectors.

New Energy Sector Layout

Under the "dual carbon" goals, the new energy industry is booming, with surging demand for automation equipment. TXAM seized the opportunity by establishing a new energy smart equipment R&D team, focusing on equipment development and manufacturing for lithium battery module PACK production lines and smart warehousing logistics systems.

Core Product Showcase

The exhibited "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" uses advanced servo drive systems and precision guide rail structures, featuring smooth operation, precise positioning, and high efficiency. It is widely applicable in new energy battery warehousing and logistics scenarios.

During the exhibition, TXAM's booth attracted numerous domestic and international customers for visits and negotiations, resulting in multiple cooperation intentions on site.
